citation.title: The deduction of low-Z ion temperature and densities in the JET tokamak using charge exchange recombination spectroscopy
citation.authors: A. Boileau, M. von Hellermann, L. D. Horton, J. Spence, H. P. Summers

topic: Visible CXRS on JET: impurity Ti from Doppler widths of beam-excited lines; impurity densities from calibrated emissivities
own_question: Can the beam-driven charge-exchange feature be isolated from edge emission to give central impurity Ti and density?
actual_method_and_evidence: Offline constrained multi-Gaussian fits separate the broad charge-exchange feature from cold edge components and blends, with instrument deconvolution. C, O and He temperatures agreed within stated errors. For carbon, Tc followed central ECE Te through sawteeth in one high-density pulse. A C-O difference histogram was centred near zero. Densities depend on modelled effective rates and beam attenuation; the authors cross-checked them against bremsstrahlung Zeff and estimate about 40% density error. Single central chord on JET, not KSTAR.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In beam-based CES/CXRS, impurity ion temperature is conventionally inferred by fitting the Doppler width of an active charge-exchange line after separating passive edge components.
claim_checks.qualification: This was offline fitting on JET with reported uncertainties of roughly 5-20% depending on line. The paper does not establish a universal procedure or a KSTAR label quality.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: CES-derived temperatures are model-dependent measurements of impurity ions, which motivates treating reports as conventional labels rather than independent truth.
claim_checks.qualification: This is our interpretation. The source shows that fit constraints, blends and atomic modelling affect results, and that only impurity Ti is measured, not main-ion Ti.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The detector supports exposures down to 10 ms at 50 Hz for C VI 529 nm. Report latency and arrival times are not addressed.
validation_if_relevant: Cross-species agreement, a single-pulse comparison with ECE Te, and a C-O histogram over 120 pulses. There is no held-out or predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite it as evidence about KSTAR, BES/ECEI, or nowcasting.
Impurity Ti agreement does not prove equality with main-ion Ti in general.
The ECE agreement is a single equipartition case and is not a calibration of Ti.
Do not cite it for real-time CES availability or latency.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: A foundational source for how CES impurity temperatures are produced and what limits them. Useful for the theoretical background on the target label.
